tokens_provenance.canvas: designed warm near-black (luma 8.7, not pure #000); pairs with the ember accent

bright_beats: NAME_HOOK: bright cream wordmark on a lit ember shader
ONLY_WHAT_WAKES: streamed experts flare to accent-ink over a dim field
TWENTY_FIVE_GIGS: full-bleed bright ember flash (inverted field, dark ink)
readability.frame_brightness_plan: dark canvas + shader lifts mean frame luma by construction (retro precedent 37->111); with >=3 bright beats the frame-brightness gate passes without lifting in the grade
readability.notes: watch mono display crowding at hero size (2026-07-02 strix lesson) -- keep big numerals inside title-safe

color_gate_note: accent hue 17 is >=60 off both prior accents (07-09 green 142, 07-10 teal 174); also a warm<->cool temperature flip AND a dark<->light canvas-value flip vs 07-10 (light). Clears variety_check color gate three ways.
